title: 第24章 性情豪放第23章 罗伦王国
content_zh:
凯撒眉毛微微一挑，有些疑惑地看着老乞丐：“照你这么说，罗伦这么一个小王国，居然能创造出格鲁姆这种人物？”
这就有些匪夷所思了，就目前整个维斯洛特来看，黄金国王似乎移植了黄金巨兽的血脉，苏尔特则疑似与狼神结合。
结果一个即将覆灭的国度，居然能掌握成为超越者的方法，这要是放到曾经的古帝国时代，起码也是一方顶尖势力。
老乞丐满脸苦涩地摇了摇头，整个人直接盘腿坐在了角落里：“王国怎么可能有那种秘法……格鲁姆是先祖从地底深处挖出来的，他是个没有任何记忆的人，连自己是谁都不知道！”
凯撒眼中骤然闪过一抹血辉，这个格鲁姆是一尊纯正的超越者，而且看上去完全保持着理智。
所以他应该不是盖狄斯的造物，否则那个老家伙早就把格鲁姆带走了。
毕竟想要单纯拥有超越者的力量，其实并不算太麻烦，但是想要真正跨越那道生命的极限，其中横亘的差距就太大了，
而老乞丐此刻已经陷入了回忆，他脸上满是懊悔与遗憾：“后来苏尔特诞生了，罗兰王国也就再也支撑不住了，最终变成了现在的埃斯弗洛冰山城。”
卡莎看着老家伙脸上那副悲伤的神色，轻轻走上前拍了拍他的肩膀：“那你怎么会落魄到现在这副样子的？”
“因为我爱上了一个女人……”老乞丐脸上的神色愈发懊悔，眼前忍不住浮现出那张温柔的面孔。
这个答案让几人的神色更加疑惑，但还不等他们开口追问，老乞丐便再次幽幽地开口：“她是北境摄政王的女人，然后我就为了她，把格鲁姆亲手送给了苏尔特。”
凯撒的眼角忍不住抽搐，苏尔特之所以让这老家伙担任城主，就因为格鲁姆始终忠诚于他。
可没想到老乞丐居然蠢到了这种地步，仅仅因为一个女人，就亲手把自己最大的底牌给送出去了。
这种事情在他看来，就相当于自己平白无故把莉娜送给了其他半神一样荒唐，难怪老乞丐根本不敢面对格鲁姆，这简直是没脸碰面。
凯撒有些无奈地敲了敲脑袋，他只可惜为什么当初从地底挖出格鲁姆的不是自己，一尊真正跨越了生命极限的超越者，就算是自己也很难创造出来。
“老家伙，你……”卡莎看着满脸懊悔的老乞丐，实在不知道该怎么开口安慰才好。
只能轻轻拍了拍他的后背，就连身旁的萨丽和萨尔诺也都是一脸复杂的表情，这种事情实在不好置评。
然而就在凯撒也正满脸可惜的时候，他骤然望向角斗场顶层的豁口，随后忽然收回思绪：“我先去见见苏尔特那个家伙！”
话音未落，他整个人便直接化作一道赤红色的流光拔地而起，朝着角斗场最顶层的出口飞去。
霎时间，角斗场环形楼层上观望的众人，皆是满脸震惊地望着那道赤红流光，没想到有人居然敢无视规则直接闯上顶层

“吼——！”
而当凯撒的身形掠过九十层附近时，身后的角斗台上却猛然传来凶戾的嘶吼，一头通体苍白的亚龙奋力朝着那道流光扑来。
他下意识回眸看去，只见这是一头宛如老虎与蝙蝠结合般的亚龙，两根足有手臂长短的尖锐獠牙从嘴中伸出。
虽然这头亚龙的体型仅有数十米长，但它的速度却罕见的迅捷，几乎在他掠过角斗台的刹那，就化作一道迅影扑来。
轰——！
不过凯撒仅仅瞄了一眼便丧失了兴趣，直接踩在了这家伙的脑袋上，身形加速朝着顶端冲去。
顿时，苍白亚龙只感觉一股恐怖的力量袭来，庞大的身躯便狼狈地坠回了角斗台，看得周围众多正在观望的大贵族满脸惊骇。
然而就在九十层以上的守卫者准备动手拦截时，角斗场顶层外的冰山边缘，却骤然传来了一道粗犷的声音。
“这是我的贵客！”
刹那间，所有守卫者满脸恭敬地望向了穹顶的方向，没有人再敢去拦截那道赤红流光。
不过与其他守卫者不同的是，身处百层的格鲁姆神色却依旧平静，从头到尾都没有想拦截那道赤红流光的意思。
他能感受到这家伙的恐怖，就算自己真的出手拦截也根本无济于事……
与此同时，整座埃斯弗洛王城的最高处，两道身影在冰山的边缘彼此对峙而立。
这里已经超出了法阵的笼罩范围，凛冽的暴风雪开始在此处肆虐，气流狂乱到足以将任何没有防护的凡人瞬间撕裂。
“没想到见你一面这么麻烦！”凯撒的眼眸微微眯起，目光落在面前这个长相粗犷的中年男人身上。
只见，对方即便身处这般极端恶劣的环境之中，整体也仅仅只用龙鳞遮盖住了下半身。
“哈哈，这句话应该是我说才对，今天终于见到传说中的半神了！”
苏尔特豪迈地整理着凌乱的长发，他这副模样看起来完全不像是掌控着整个北境的至高君主，反而更像是某个落魄的大贵族。
“看来你知道的东西不少……”凯撒心中确实有几分诧异，但想到连乌尔里克那个家伙都能知道，那苏尔特恐怕也清楚。
然而就在他准备先开口谈谈有关异族动向的问题时，苏尔特却忽然满脸战意地盯着的青年，脸上没有任何算计。

“我们北境人的脑子很简单，等会只要你能打败我，深渊的事情我听你的！”
凯撒神色微微一愣，随即同样露出一抹带着几分欣赏的豪迈笑容，他就喜欢这种简单直接的家伙：“好！”
“哈哈，希望你能让我的血液真正沸腾起来！”
苏尔特脸上的笑容愈发兴奋，周身弥漫的寒雾开始缓缓收缩，渐渐形成了走向角斗场内的阶梯……
content_en:
Caesar raised his eyebrows slightly and looked at the old beggar with some confusion: "According to you, a small kingdom like Loren can actually create a character like Grum?"
This is a bit strange. From the current perspective of the entire Westeros, the Golden King seems to have transplanted the blood of the golden beast, and Surt is suspected of being combined with the Wolf God.
As a result, a country that was about to be destroyed could actually master the method of becoming a transcendent. This would have been at least a top force in the ancient empire era.
The old beggar shook his head with a bitter look on his face, and sat cross-legged in the corner: "How could the kingdom have such a secret method...Grum was dug out from the depths of the earth by the ancestors. He is a person without any memory, and he doesn't even know who he is!"
A flash of blood suddenly flashed in Caesar's eyes. This Grum was a pure transcendent, and he seemed to be completely rational.
So he shouldn't be Geddes's creation, otherwise the old guy would have taken Grum away long ago.
After all, it is not too troublesome to simply possess the power of a transcendent, but if you want to truly cross the limit of life, the gap is too big.
The old beggar had already fallen into memories at this moment, and his face was full of remorse and regret: "Later, Sirte was born, and the Kingdom of Roland could no longer support it, and eventually it became the current Iceberg City of Esflor."
Kasha looked at the sad look on the old guy's face, stepped forward and patted him on the shoulder: "Then how did you end up in such a miserable state?"
"Because I fell in love with a woman..." The expression on the old beggar's face became more and more regretful, and he couldn't help but see that gentle face in front of his eyes.
This answer made the expressions of several people even more confused, but before they could ask further questions, the old beggar spoke quietly again: "She is the woman of the regent of the North, and for her, I personally gave Grum to Surte."
Caesar's eyes couldn't help but twitch. The reason why Surt made this old guy the city leader was because Grum had always been loyal to him.
But I didn't expect that the old beggar would be so stupid as to give away his biggest trump card just because of a woman.
In his opinion, this kind of thing was as absurd as giving Lina to other demigods for no reason. No wonder the old beggar didn't dare to face Grum. This was simply shameless.
Caesar knocked his head helplessly. He regretted why he was not the one who dug out Grum from the ground in the first place. It would be difficult even for him to create a Transcendent who truly crossed the limits of life.
"Old guy, you..." Kasha looked at the remorseful old beggar and really didn't know how to comfort him.
He could only pat him on the back gently, and even Sally and Sarno beside him had complicated expressions on their faces. It was really difficult to comment on this kind of thing.
However, just when Caesar was full of regret, he suddenly looked at the gap on the top floor of the arena, and then suddenly retracted his thoughts: "I'll go see that guy Surte first!"
Before he finished speaking, his whole body turned into a red stream of light and rose from the ground, flying towards the top exit of the arena.
In an instant, everyone watching on the circular floor of the arena looked at the red stream of light with shock on their faces. They did not expect that someone would dare to ignore the rules and go directly to the top floor.
"Ho--!"
And when Caesar's figure passed near the ninetieth floor, a ferocious roar suddenly came from the arena behind him, and a pale dragon rushed towards the stream of light.
He subconsciously looked back and saw that it was a sub-dragon that looked like a combination of a tiger and a bat, with two sharp fangs as long as arms protruding from its mouth.
Although this sub-dragon is only tens of meters long, its speed is extremely fast. Almost as soon as it passed the arena, it turned into a bolt of lightning.The shadow came.
boom--!
However, Caesar lost interest after just one glance. He stepped directly on the guy's head and accelerated towards the top.
Suddenly, the pale dragon felt a terrifying power coming, and his huge body fell back into the arena in a panic, making the many noble nobles who were watching around him look horrified.
However, just when the defenders above the 90th floor were about to intercept, a rough voice suddenly came from the edge of the iceberg outside the top floor of the arena.
"This is my distinguished guest!"
In an instant, all the guards looked respectfully in the direction of the dome, and no one dared to intercept the red stream of light.
However, unlike other defenders, Groom, who was on the 100th floor, still looked calm, and had no intention of intercepting the red stream of light from beginning to end.
He could feel the terror of this guy, and even if he really tried to intercept it, it would be of no avail...
At the same time, at the highest point of the entire King Esflor City, two figures stood facing each other on the edge of the iceberg.
This place has exceeded the coverage of the magic circle, and the biting blizzard has begun to rage here, and the air flow is crazy enough to tear any unprotected mortal apart instantly.
"I didn't expect it would be so troublesome to meet you!" Caesar's eyes narrowed slightly, and his eyes fell on the rough-looking middle-aged man in front of him.
I saw that even though the opponent was in such an extremely harsh environment, he only covered his lower body with dragon scales.
"Haha, I should be the one to say this. Today I finally met the legendary demigod!"
Surte boldly arranged his messy long hair. His appearance did not look like the supreme monarch who controlled the entire northern territory, but more like a down-and-out noble.
"It seems you know a lot..." Caesar was indeed a little surprised, but thinking that even Ulrik knew it, Surte probably knew it too.
However, just when he was about to talk about the movements of alien races, Surte suddenly stared at the young man with a warlike face, without any calculation on his face.
"We northerners have very simple minds. As long as you can defeat me later, I will listen to you about the abyss!"
Caesar's expression was slightly startled, and then he showed a heroic smile with a bit of appreciation. He liked this kind of simple and direct guy: "Okay!"
"Haha, I hope you can make my blood really boil!"
The smile on Surte's face became more and more excited, and the cold mist surrounding him began to slowly shrink, gradually forming a staircase leading into the arena...
